headline: Executive order changes the earlier order that set up the President's Foreign Intelligence Advisory Board.
what_it_does: This order amends Executive Order 12863, the 1993 order that created the President's Foreign Intelligence Advisory Board. That board is a group of outside advisers who review US intelligence work and give the President advice. The title does not say what specific changes were made.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the President's Foreign Intelligence Advisory Board
who_it_affects.how: The rules for how their advisory board works are changed, though the title does not say how.
